foreach.description: Run these steps once for each item in a list. Useful for handling contacts, rows, files, or other items one at a time.
foreach.name: foreach

parameters.description: The list or collection to loop over.
parameters.name: items

returns.description: No output. Inside the loop, each item in turn is available under the loop variable's name.

repeat.description: Run these steps a fixed number of times. Use this when you know exactly how many times the steps should run.
repeat.name: repeat

parameters.description: How many times to run the steps. Must be a whole number that is zero or greater.
parameters.name: count

returns.description: No output. The steps inside run the given number of times.

while.description: Repeat these steps while something is true. Use this when you do not know ahead of time how many times the steps should run.
while.name: while

parameters.description: The condition checked before each iteration. The loop keeps running as long as it holds. Make sure something in the loop eventually makes it false.
parameters.name: condition

returns.description: No output. The steps inside repeat for as long as the condition holds.
